maya: Onboarding fusion-3b-int4: quick smoke shows QA drop ~6%. Suspect tokenizer merge + rotary handshake mismatch.

oliver: Which tokenizer? Repo one or our canonical?

maya: Repo tokenizer (fusion/tokenizer.json). Quick repro prompt: "How to revoke access for ex-employee?"

jess: Dumped ids: repo -> [120,4523,78]; canonical -> [120,45,23,78]. Repo merged "revoke access" into single id 4523. That will shift kvcache indexing.

sam: Also check rotary_meta in converted model. If training used headwise frequencies but runtime uses shared, ordering subtlety appears as rank errors.

maya: Ran tiny ablation: `./onboard_eval.sh --model fusion-3b --quant int4-perhead --seed 7`. int4-perhead w/ repo tokenizer: EM 0.76. int4-perhead w/ canonical remap: EM 0.69. float32 baseline EM 0.82.

ci-bot: CI: onboard/fusion-3b-int4 1% tests failed; logs: https://ci.redwood.example/runs/204/logs

oliver: Plan: 1) run tools/vocab_roundtrip.py over 5k lines, 2) add kv-index trace in runtime for first 64 tokens, 3) assert rotary_mode from model metadata in harness. I'll take vocab work.

jess: I'll add small runtime flag `--debug-kv-map` that prints `token_id->kv_idx` for failing CI runs.

maya: Thanks. Drop PR/CI links here when ready; if fix doesn't recover >3% we'll escalate to quant per-layer diffs.
